title: Provenance Record (MPA v1)
description: One claim-bearing decision bound to four typed origin slots: Evidence, Hypothesis, Measurement Contract, Measurement Execution. FROZEN v1.0.0. A record proves the ORIGIN of a claim is recoverable — never that the claim is true, economic, or authorised (CLAUDE.md §6.5). Authoritative prose: docs/governance/MEASUREMENT_PROVENANCE_ARCHITECTURE.md. Implementation: src/governance/provenance_record.py.

subject.description: The natural key of an EXISTING record. This layer mints no identifiers for subjects. SESSION LOG entries are deliberately excluded: 1,052 of the 2026-08-26 audit's 1,170 decisions are session entries and most record no architectural decision, so admitting them would rebuild the audit's denominator problem inside the ledger.

id.description: F-094 | CH-<slug> | promotion-log line timestamp | closure surface_id

slots.description: UNKNOWN is recorded by OMISSION (null / empty list), never asserted as a value. `evidence` is a list because a claim may rest on several artifacts; the other three hold at most one binding.

chain_class.description: The WEAKEST non-UNKNOWN class among bindings that resolve, or UNKNOWN. COMPUTED, never caller-supplied — a supplied value disagreeing with the bindings is rejected. Weakest-wins is what stops coverage being inflated by attesting everything.

chain_complete.description: True only when all four slots carry at least one binding that RESOLVES. A binding naming a target that does not exist is recorded so the dangling citation stays visible, but does not complete the chain. COMPUTED, never caller-supplied.

grants_authority.description: PINNED. Provenance completeness is not validity, is not economic value, and is not authority. Mirrors economic_claims_allowed in measurement_result_log.jsonl.

resolution.description: EXPLICIT = the subject's own record names the target. Backfill can NEVER produce EXPLICIT. DERIVED = mechanically reproducible by a named, versioned rule. ATTESTED = a human/agent adjudication. UNKNOWN is not a value here — it is the absence of a binding.

resolves.description: The target exists and, for paths, is GIT-TRACKED. `git ls-files`, never the filesystem: an untracked path points at nothing from any other clone (39 of 374 finding evidence refs are untracked today).

witness.description: The literal bytes justifying this binding — the field, path, or digest that was read.

caveat.description: Where a rule is weaker than it looks. D3/D4 reconstruct through a registry whose 18-of-20 records were authored on 2026-07-03 about completed work: reproducible is not contemporaneous.

oneOf.description: An attestation is a claim someone stands behind, so it records who, when, on what basis, and under whose authority. All four are required and non-empty.
